title: For each network, return the network ID and the total number of subnets on
question: For each network, return the network ID and the total number of subnets on that network, considering only ACTIVE networks that have the RBAC permission action set to 'access_as_shared', and only keeping networks whose total subnet count is more than one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) above the mean subnet count across all such ACTIVE networks. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(s.id) AS subnet_count
  FROM networks n
  JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id
  LEFT JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
  WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.action = 'access_as_shared'
  GROUP BY n.id
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(subnet_count) AS mean_cnt, STDDEV(subnet_count) AS sd_cnt
  FROM base
)
SELECT b.network_id, b.subnet_count
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN stats st
WHERE b.subnet_count > st.mean_cnt + st.sd_cnt
ORDER BY b.network_id;

Do not return any rounded answers.
